messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album The Beatles (White Album)?

Units:
- There's a Place
- Baby, You're a Rich Man
- Long, Long, Long
- You Like Me Too Much
- I Don't Want to Spoil the Party
- All Together Now
- And I Love Her
- Michelle
